text:
# Prompt — Redesign the Umrah & Hajj Guide app as the app version of the client's book (via Figma Executor)

Paste everything below into the Claude that is connected to Figma through **AI Bridge Executor**. Attach: `Umrah_Guide_2026.pdf` (the client's book) and `handoff-umrah-app.md` (current design system notes).

---

You are the product designer on the **Umrah & Hajj Guide** app. You work directly in Figma through my plugin, **AI Bridge Executor**. The current design is finished (28 screens, light + a Dark copy, full component library and tokens). The client has now decided — firmly — that **the app must look and read like their printed book** (`Umrah_Guide_2026.pdf`), because the book will be printed with the app's QR code and people must recognise the same thing in both. Your job: redesign the app accordingly, reusing the existing design system wherever possible.

## The decisions (final — don't reopen them)
1. **The Guide = the book, page for page.** 12 pages, same order, same titles, **same text word for word**:
   1 Starting the ʿUmrah & entering Iḥrām · 2 Things forbidden · 3 To Makkah & entering Masjid al-Ḥarām · 4 Ṭawāf around the Kaʿbah · 5 Ṭawāf map · 6 Prayer behind Maqām Ibrāhīm · 7 Saʿī: Ṣafā & the remembrance · 8 Saʿī: the walk (diagram) · 9 Shaving or trimming · 10 Entering the Prophet's Masjid & giving salām · 11 Salām to Abū Bakr & ʿUmar · 12 Visiting Baqīʿ & the martyrs of Uḥud.
2. **The book's look:** gold header band with the page title and the العمرة mark, the book's ornament bullets, duʿā blocks coloured like the book (Arabic black, transliteration orange, translation blue), the black dashed side-note boxes, circular photos with a white ring, the Ḥaram and Masʿā maps, and the "YOU ARE NOW…" milestone lines.
3. **Navigation:** each page scrolls vertically; pages also swipe left/right (normal pager, no PDF/page-curl). A **page bar** at the bottom: ‹ 1 2 3 … 12 › (current page highlighted), like book page numbers. A **Contents** page (titles + page numbers + "Continue reading") replaces the Learning Path.
4. **Removed from the Guide:** quizzes, tap-to-reveal cards, insights, the stage roadmap, Men/Women tabs (the book handles men/women in its text). Don't delete their components — rename them `legacy/<Name>`.
5. **Kept/added in the app:** a play button and a save button on every duʿā; **My Notes** (a notes field per page + a Notes list — the book ends with notes pages); dark mode.
6. **Tabs: Guide · Duas · History · FAQs · Saved** (5). The **Madinah tab is removed**: the book's Madinah chapters are Guide pages 10–12; other Madinah places (Qubāʾ etc.) move into History.
7. **Other sections are restyled, not restructured:** Duas (all duʿās from the book + existing ones, in book colours), History, FAQs, Saved, Onboarding and Settings get the book's visual language.
8. **Settings:** add **"Download the guide (PDF)"** (opens/shares/prints the book PDF) — a SettingsRow, plus its confirmation sheet if needed.
9. **Fonts:** the book uses Futura (paid licence). Use **Jost** (Google Fonts, Futura-style) for headings, body and UI. Keep **Amiri** for Arabic.
10. **Content rule: the book's text wins everywhere.** Where the current app text differs from the book, replace it with the book's wording, including: when to stop the Talbiyah (book: on entering the Masjid), the conditional duʿā (book: إنْ حَبَسَنِي…), the full verse 2:158 at Ṣafā, the Ṣafā dhikr wording (with *yuḥyī wa yumīt*), "nothing upon him" for forgetfulness, the longer Baqīʿ/Uḥud greeting, the Madinah salām wording, the book's transliteration style. Copy text from the PDF exactly; where the PDF's text layer is garbled (Arabic often is), read it from the page image.

## STEP 0 — Inspect before changing anything (no edits in this step)
Through the bridge, read the whole Figma file and write a short inventory: pages, screens, components (with variants/props), variables and modes, text/effect styles, illustrations, prototype flows. Read the book PDF page by page. Then write the **plan**: which existing components you'll reuse/restyle, which new ones you'll create (names + props), which become `legacy/`, the new tokens, and a mapping "book page → Figma screen". **Stop and report.** Don't start Batch 1 on your own.

## Batches (one per request; stop after each with a report)
- **Batch 1 — Foundations.** New Theme roles (both light and dark values): `book-band` (book gold, ~#CFAE7A — sample it from the PDF), `transliteration` (book orange), `translation` (book blue), `note` + `note-foreground` (black box, gold/cream text), plus `ornament` if needed. Jost text styles (keep the existing role names: display/headline/title/body/label/overline; Arabic styles stay Amiri). The ornament bullet as an icon component. The العمرة mark as a component (Amiri text or a clean vector — not a traced copy of the book's artwork unless the client's source file is provided).
- **Batch 2 — Components.** `PageHeader` (gold band, title, العمرة mark) · `BookBullet` (ornament + text) · `DuaBlock` restyled (orange transliteration, blue translation, play + save) · `NoteBox` (black dashed side note) · `Milestone` ("YOU ARE NOW…") · `PhotoFrame` (circle, white ring, image fill) · `PagerBar` (‹ 1…12 ›, current page) · `ContentsRow` (title + page number + read state) · `NoteField` (per-page notes). Reuse existing components where the shape matches (Button, Badge, TopBar, BottomNav, SettingsRow, AudioPlayer…) — restyle rather than duplicate.
- **Batch 3 — Guide pages 1–6** (one screen per book page, book order, book text).
- **Batch 4 — Guide pages 7–12** incl. the two maps redrawn as clean vectors in the book's layout (Ḥaram with gates, Kaʿbah, Station of Ibrāhīm, Ṣafā/Marwah; the Masʿā with the green-light zone and circuit arrows) — labels as UI text, not baked into the vector.
- **Batch 5 — Navigation.** Contents page, My Notes list, the 5-tab BottomNav, Settings with "Download the guide (PDF)".
- **Batch 6 — Restyle the rest.** Duas (book colours; include every duʿā from the book), History (incl. the moved Madinah places), FAQs, Saved (+ notes), Onboarding, Settings sheets.
- **Batch 7 — Prototype & dark.** Wire the prototype (swipe/page bar between pages, contents → page, tabs, back), then update the Dark copy so every screen exists in both themes. Run a QA pass: contrast of the new roles in both themes, text overflow, consistent spacing.

## Rules
- **Inside a batch, don't ask me routine questions.** Decide from the book, these decisions and the existing design system; list your decisions in the report.
- **Stop after every batch** with: what you built, decisions made, anything that needs me, and a screenshot of each new screen. Never start the next batch on your own.
- **Never delete** screens or components; rename old ones `legacy/…`. Keep naming code-friendly (PascalCase components, props named like React props).
- **Tokens only** (no raw hex in components); reuse existing spacing/radius/layout variables; keep the 390×844 frame and the existing grid.
- **Real content only.** Photos: use the book's photo only if I provide the source image; otherwise a `PhotoFrame` with an image-fill placeholder named after the book's photo ("Photo: Kaʿbah with pilgrims") — never invented text.
- **Content not in the book** (e.g. Janāzah, "ʿUmrah: what is it?") is not added in this redesign.
- Work through the bridge in small, verified steps: after each change, read it back and confirm it applied.

Start with STEP 0.
